CIV.note: The article is about a survey data release and states no open data policy.

facts.fact: FAO says Cote d'Ivoire's agriculture ministry released the 2024-2025 annual agricultural survey results, with open data tables on the national Open Data portal and anonymised microdata in the national microdata catalogue.
facts.system: Cote d'Ivoire national Open Data portal and NADA microdata catalogue
